messages:
leah (oncall): incident-bot paged me for a spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts in eu-west-1, started ~04:12 UTC. seeing a bunch of 502/504 on /v1/generate and streaming sessions timing out.
incident-bot: Pager: oncall=leah, escalation=omar, severity=sev2. Metric: 6.3% 5xx last 3m.
devops-bot: Alert detail: kv-prefix-cache latency p99 increased from 60ms -> 1.2s; kv-shard-proxy saw connection resets.
omar: quick check: hostname kv-prefix-prim-03 shows repeated compaction logs at 04:09. Could be compaction + eviction churn.
tess: I'm prefix-cache lead, on it. We deployed a TTL/eviction tweak 30m ago to reduce memory high-water. Will check compaction windows.
leah (oncall): assign tess as cache owner for this incident. Omar, can you propose immediate mitigation?
omar: immediate steps: 1) route high-QPS streaming and embeddings away from prefix-cache to direct-kv reads, 2) throttle compaction jobs, 3) temporary circuit-breaker on kv-shard-proxy to fail fast.
sre-rotations: Running route bypass for /v1/embeddings now. Command: `/routes set-bypass --path /v1/embeddings --target direct-kv --reason "live mitigate prefix-cache latency"`
devops-bot: Command ack: route bypass applied to eu-west-1. Affected pods: gateway-001..004.
support-eng: Customer impact: two enterprise tenants reported 10-20% request failures, one started automated retries and hit rate limits. They want an ETA.
leah (oncall): short update to customers: "We're investigating higher error rates impacting generation and embeddings. We have applied temporary routing mitigations and are actively rolling back a cache config change if correlated. More updates in 15m."
tess: on the cache side we see eviction storms: compaction is holding shard locks longer, causing GC p99 spikes and blocking cache responses. Also observed checksum mismatch logs for certain prefix indexes after compaction.
omar: checksum mismatches -> any chance of silent corruption?
tess: not sure yet. The matches are transient and later reconcile, but the frequent recompute causes eviction churn.
leah (oncall): execute canary rollback of the eviction tweak in az-west-2. tess can you run?
tess: starting canary rollback: `/config rollback prefix-eviction-tweak --canary az-west-2 --reason "mitigate eviction churn"`
devops-bot: Rollback job started job=rb-510001-01.
incident-bot: Note: compaction job schedule at 04:09:22Z may have coincided with config change window. Correlation flag set.
oscar (typo): sorry ignore (bot noise).
support-eng: CS escalations: two in-app tickets and an active live chat for one customer. Flagging possible SLA breach.
leah (oncall): timeboxing: if we see improvement in 7m post-rollback, proceed rollout; otherwise expand bypass to /v1/generate.
omar: added temporary circuit-breaker: kv-shard-proxy fail-fast 150ms. This should prevent long tails. Command: `/proxy cb --service kv-shard-proxy --threshold 150ms --mode failfast`
devops-bot: Circuit-breaker applied.
tess: canary rollback complete in az-west-2 at 04:22 UTC, no immediate regressions observed. Rolling to other AZs.
incident-bot: Metrics: overall 5xx decreased from 6.3% -> 2.7% within 6m of mitigations. Streaming timeouts reduced but some retries still failing.
support-eng: we sent interim note to affected customers and offered to escalate for SLA credits. Legal/finance notified.
leah (oncall): good. Next: root cause triage. tess please capture compaction config, GC traces, and checksum logs. Omar, create follow-up ticket for adding compaction safety: stagger compaction across shards, backpressure, and emergency bypass runbook.
omar: creating ticket: PM-510001 with timeline, metrics, and proposed fixes.
tess: initial hypothesis: aggressive eviction-window + compaction concurrency created lock contention -> long GC pauses -> prefix-cache requests time out -> kv-shard-proxy overloaded with fallback reads -> gateway 5xx/timeouts. Also checksum recomputes spiked due to compaction race.
sre-rotations: added alert: prefix-cache compaction duration > 90s -> auto-throttle compaction and trigger bypass.
devops-bot: Observability note: saved heap dump and GC logs to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/5100012345/
support-eng: Customer update draft: "We experienced elevated error rates due to a prefix cache compaction and eviction interaction. We've routed traffic to direct reads and rolled back a recent config change. Services are recovering; a post-incident report with RCA and mitigations will follow."
leah (oncall): handoff: I'm out for the night. Omar and tess own the remediation and postmortem. Leave this thread open for 2h monitoring.
omar: acknowledged. Taking incident lead for postmortem and follow-up actions.
tess: acknowledged. Will open RCA and link artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. start=04:12:30Z, mitigation actions=[route-bypass, circuit-breaker, rollback-eviction-tweak].
devops-bot: Postmortem skeleton created: PM-510001, attached logs, metric snapshots, and runbook action items.
support-eng: We'll coordinate customer comms and SLA assessments with legal.
leah (oncall): thanks team. closing handoff. :thumbsup:
